provenance.source_title: POV You're Every Rank In The Chinese Triad

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个普通劳动场景的崩塌瞬间建立绝境与同情
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常画面 + 突发事件 + 地域锚点
examples.example_text: Your father collapses during the dinner rush. One moment he's pulling noodles behind the counter of your family's shop in Sham Shui Po.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"One moment... the next..."的对比结构把日常生活切开
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制人物关系与地名

examples.psychological_goal: 违反常理的巨额现金以动作白描登场，观众与主角同时屏息
examples.expression_mechanism: 动作三连 + 道具具现
examples.example_text: He slides an envelope across the table. You open it. Cash. Thick stacks of thousand-dollar bills.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"递过—打开—现金"的三个短动作让关键道具自己说话，不加一句评论
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制信封与钞票的具体形式

examples.psychological_goal: 组织名曝光与既成事实同帧，观众和主角一起后知后觉
examples.expression_mechanism: 名称落地 + 既成事实判词
examples.example_text: You just joined the 14K, the oldest triad in Hong Kong, and you didn't even know it until it was too late.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把"你已经是X了"放在主角知情之后宣布，制造命运错位感
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制组织名称与地域

examples.psychological_goal: 命名职级并同时给出其残酷属性与微弱希望
examples.expression_mechanism: 职级标签 + 三连定性 + 转折
examples.example_text: You're a 49er now, the lowest rank in the triad. A foot soldier, disposable, but you're learning.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你是X了：A，B，但你还有C"的句式给新身份定调
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制职级名称与编号

examples.psychological_goal: 用誓言的具体惩罚展示组织规则的严苛与古老
examples.expression_mechanism: 条件句排比 + 具象刑罚
examples.example_text: If you betray your brothers, you will die by a thousand cuts. If you reveal triad secrets, you will be drowned.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"If you X, you will Y"的誓言排比逐条加码，关闭退出的想象

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个生理动作完成终身绑定的定格
examples.expression_mechanism: 动作即契约 + 三连否定
examples.example_text: The moment you swallow, you're bound for life. There's no resignation, no retirement, no escape clause.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把抽象约束绑定到一个具体动作上，并用三个"没有"封死退路

examples.psychological_goal: 战争结束但人已不可逆，道德临界点以排除法冷陈述跨过
examples.expression_mechanism: 转折宣告 + 排除法定性
examples.example_text: The war ends. But you're different now. You've killed a man. Not in self-defense, not in passion, because you were told to.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"不是A，不是B，是C"的排除结构给行为定性，让最后一个理由最冷

examples.psychological_goal: 家庭线的悲剧反讽：被拯救者永远不知道代价
examples.example_text: He has no idea what you've become to save him.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"他不知道你为了救他变成了什么"把两条线拧成一刀
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物关系设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个荒谬的数字差把洗钱机制讲明白
examples.expression_mechanism: 具体场景 + 不可能的数字 + 拟人化收尾
examples.example_text: A noodle shop that seats 20 people reports serving 300 customers a day. The register rings up phantom transactions.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"容纳X却申报Y"的数字矛盾演示一个灰色机制
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制店铺类型与数字

examples.psychological_goal: 开局前提被整体翻转：债是虚构的，拥有才是目的
examples.example_text: The debt was never real. It was just the excuse they needed to own you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在故事中后段宣布"开局的X从来不存在"，迫使观众重看一切
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 debt/own 的措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句对照完成全部得失结算
examples.expression_mechanism: 对照判词（saved X, lost Y）
examples.example_text: You saved your father's life, but you lost everything else.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你保住了X，但失去了其余一切"的句式给一整条故事线结账
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该对照的具体内容

examples.psychological_goal: 登顶时刻宣布自由的彻底缺席，顶点即囚笼
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连排比 + 否定 + 时态推到"从未"
examples.example_text: You're at the top now. You have power, you have wealth, you have respect, but you're not free. You've never been free.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给足三连"你拥有"，再用"但你没有"抽掉，并把时态推到从来
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 power/wealth/respect 的排比

examples.psychological_goal: 地点反讽：主角被送进他送别人去过的地方
examples.example_text: You're sent to Stanley Prison, maximum security, the same prison you sent others to for decades.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让结局地点与主角曾经的权力行为重叠，形成地理上的命运回环

examples.psychological_goal: 开局母题终极翻转：债务从情节装置变成命运本身
examples.example_text: All that's left is the debt, the one you can never repay.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开局的具体债务在结尾抽象化为"永远还不清的那笔"
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 debt 的回环方式
